engagement_cards.title: Verify Intel Item
engagement_cards.description: Fact-check an unconfirmed note so you don't pitch on false assumptions.

engagement_cards.title: 1-to-1 Meeting
engagement_cards.description: Book dedicated face time with 1 stakeholder to ask 3 targeted questions.
engagement_cards.response_snippet: In our 1-to-1 meeting, we discussed key technical and operational requirements in detail.

engagement_cards.title: Probe Requirements
engagement_cards.description: Ask 1 stakeholder about requirements across MLOps components.

engagement_cards.title: Team Sync-Up
engagement_cards.description: Call a team sync-up across top affected MLOps components. (1x per phase)
engagement_cards.response_snippet: Synced up with all team members to align perspectives.

engagement_cards.title: Ask Generic Question
engagement_cards.description: Lightweight query to gauge general sentiment and open preferences.
engagement_cards.response_snippet: Gauged general sentiment and high-level priorities.

engagement_cards.title: Investigate Component
engagement_cards.description: Inspect an MLOps component to discover factual information about its state and dependencies.
engagement_cards.response_snippet: Discovered facts about the inspected component.
